name: Cultist: Teachings of Mythrax lengthens Presence of Y'Shaarj's cursed ground by 25% (#1054)
contract: Teachings of Mythrax 561035 (Spell.dbc, family 31, passive) reads 'Increases the duration of Presence of N'Zoth and Presence of Y'Shaarj by $s1%.' ($s1 = 25). Its SPELLMOD_DURATION class mask (word0 0x08000000) misses both Presence stances and selects Presence of Y'Shaarj 807632, the record whose duration Presence of Y'Shaarj 803035's tooltip quotes ('giving damage dealt a $h% chance to curse the ground for $807632d', DurationIndex 29 = 12000 ms). aura_ascension_cultist_event implements that curse with the ground effect Despoiled Ground 805180 (SPELL_EFFECT_PERSISTENT_AREA_AURA, also 12000 ms), whose family flags are 0, so no class mask can reach it and the talent never applied. Expected: with the talent every cursed ground Presence of Y'Shaarj creates lasts 12000 * 1.25 = 15000 ms; before the fix it lasts 12000 ms. Eight fixture golems in two 20 sec ground effects (43429 and 17742, one-second ticks) give the proc many damage events; the first Despoiled Ground must appear with more than 14 sec remaining, and every one must be gone within 16 sec once Presence is removed.
